// Diagnostic codes discovered in the Java source.
// Add the matching entries to internal/diag/diag.go.
//
//   JSC_MISPLACED_MSG_ANNOTATION (disabled)
//   JSC_MISPLACED_ANNOTATION (warning)
//   JSC_ANNOTATION_DEPRECATED (warning)
//   JSC_DISALLOWED_MEMBER_JSDOC (warning)
//   JSC_ARROW_FUNCTION_AS_CONSTRUCTOR (error)
//   JSC_BAD_REST_PARAMETER_ANNOTATION (warning)
//   JSC_DEFAULT_PARAM_MUST_BE_MARKED_OPTIONAL (error)
//   JSC_INVALID_NO_SIDE_EFFECT_ANNOTATION (error)
//   JSC_INVALID_MODIFIES_ANNOTATION (error)
//   JSC_INVALID_DEFINE_ON_LET (error)
//   JSC_MISPLACED_SUPPRESS (warning)
//   JSC_JSDOC_IN_BLOCK_COMMENT (warning)
//   JSC_JSDOC_ON_RETURN (warning)

// Checks for misplaced, misused or deprecated JSDoc annotations.
type CheckJSDoc struct {
	Compiler *Compiler
	InExterns bool
	// TODO: Java type CheckJsdocTypes not mapped
	CheckJsDocTypesVisitor CheckJsdocTypes
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:70
func NewCheckJSDoc(compiler *Compiler) *CheckJSDoc {
	c := &CheckJSDoc{}
	c.compiler = compiler
	return c
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:75
func (c *CheckJSDoc) Process(externs *rhino.Node, root *rhino.Node) {
	inExterns = true
	NodeTraversal.Traverse(compiler, externs, c)
	inExterns = false
	NodeTraversal.Traverse(compiler, root, c)
}

// .
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:86
func (c *CheckJSDoc) checkJsDocInBlockComments(fileName string) {
	if !compiler.GetOptions().PreservesDetailedSourceInfo() {
		return
	}
	for _, comment := range compiler.GetComments(fileName) {
		if comment.typ == Comment.Type.BLOCK {
			if COMMENT_PATTERN.Matcher(comment.value).Find() {
				compiler.Report(JSError.Make(fileName, comment.location.start.line + 1, comment.location.start.column, JSDOC_IN_BLOCK_COMMENT))
			}
		}
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:107
func (c *CheckJSDoc) Visit(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) {
	if n.IsScript() {
		CheckJsDocInBlockComments(n.GetSourceFileName())
	}
	info := n.GetJSDocInfo()
	ValidateTypeAnnotations(n, info)
	ValidateFunctionJsDoc(n, info)
	ValidateMsgJsDoc(n, info)
	ValidateNoCollapse(n, info)
	ValidateClassLevelJsDoc(n, info)
	ValidateArrowFunction(n)
	ValidateRestParameter(n)
	ValidateDefaultValue(n)
	ValidateTemplates(n, info)
	ValidateTypedefs(n, info)
	ValidateNoSideEffects(n, info)
	ValidateAbstractJsDoc(n, info)
	ValidateDefinesDeclaration(n, info)
	ValidateSuppress(n, info)
	ValidateImplicitCast(n, info)
	ValidateClosurePrimitive(n, info)
	ValidateReturnJsDoc(n, info)
	ValidateTsType(n, info)
	ValidateJsDocTypeNames(info)
	ValidateIsUsedViaDotConstructor(n, info)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:134
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateSuppress(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil || info.GetSuppressions().IsEmpty() {
		return
	}
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
	if ContainsOnlySuppressionFor(info, "missingRequire") {
		return
	}
	if n.GetParent().IsExprResult() {
		return
	}
	compiler.Report(JSError.Make(n, MISPLACED_SUPPRESS))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:179
func containsOnlySuppressionFor(jsdoc *rhino.JSDocInfo, allowedSuppression string) bool {
	suppressions := jsdoc.GetSuppressions()
	return suppressions.Size() == 1 && Iterables.GetOnlyElement(suppressions).Equals(allowedSuppression)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:185
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateTypedefs(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil || !info.HasTypedefType() {
		return
	}
	if IsClassDecl(n) {
		ReportMisplaced(n, "typedef", "@typedef is not allowed on a class declaration.")
		return
	}
	lvalue := func() any { if NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(n) || n.IsAssign() { return n.GetFirstChild() }; return n }()
	if !lvalue.IsQualifiedName() {
		ReportMisplaced(n, "typedef", "@typedef is only allowed on qualified name declarations. Did you mean @type?")
	} else if IsPrototypeOrInstanceDecl(lvalue) {
		ReportMisplaced(n, "typedef", "@typedef is not allowed on instance or prototype properties. Did you mean @type?")
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:207
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateTemplates(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info != nil && !info.GetTemplateTypeNames().IsEmpty() && !info.IsConstructorOrInterface() && !IsClassDecl(n) && !info.ContainsFunctionDeclaration() && GetFunctionDecl(n) == nil {
		ReportMisplaced(n, "template", "@template is only allowed in class, constructor, interface, function " + "or method declarations")
	}
}

// Returns: The function node associated with the function declaration associated with the
//     specified node, no null if no such function exists.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:226
func getFunctionDecl(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	if n.IsFunction() {
		return n
	}
	if n.IsMemberFunctionDef() {
		return n.GetFirstChild()
	}
	if NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(n) && n.GetFirstFirstChild() != nil && n.GetFirstFirstChild().IsFunction() {
		return n.GetFirstFirstChild()
	}
	if n.IsAssign() && n.GetFirstChild().IsQualifiedName() && n.GetLastChild().IsFunction() {
		return n.GetLastChild()
	}
	if n.IsGetterDef() || n.IsSetterDef() {
		return n.GetFirstChild()
	}
	if n.IsComputedProp() && n.GetLastChild().IsFunction() {
		return n.GetLastChild()
	}
	return nil
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:254
func (c *CheckJSDoc) isClassDecl(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsClass(n) || n.IsAssign() && IsClass(n.GetLastChild()) || NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(n) && IsNameInitializeWithClass(n.GetFirstChild()) || IsNameInitializeWithClass(n)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:261
func (c *CheckJSDoc) isNameInitializeWithClass(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n != nil && n.IsName() && n.HasChildren() && IsClassDecl(n.GetFirstChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:265
func (c *CheckJSDoc) isClass(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsClass() || n.IsCall() && compiler.GetCodingConvention().IsClassFactoryCall(n)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:269
func isPrototypeOrInstanceDecl(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if n.IsStringKey() {
		return false
	}
	if NodeUtil.IsPrototypeProperty(n) {
		return true
	}
	receiver := NodeUtil.GetRootOfQualifiedName(n)
	return receiver.IsThis() || receiver.IsSuper()
}

// Checks that class-level annotations like @interface/@extends are not used on member functions.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:283
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateClassLevelJsDoc(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info != nil && n.IsMemberFunctionDef() && HasClassLevelJsDoc(info) {
		Report(n, DISALLOWED_MEMBER_JSDOC)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:289
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateAbstractJsDoc(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil || !info.IsAbstract() {
		return
	}
	if IsClassDecl(n) {
		return
	}
	if n.IsGetProp() {
		if !n.GetFirstChild().IsThis() && info.GetReturnType() != nil {
			Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "@abstract", "abstract undeclared methods can only be written as class fields")
		} else if !n.GetParent().IsExprResult() && n.GetGrandparent().IsBlock() && n.GetParent().GetGrandparent().IsFunction() {
			Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "@abstract", "abstract methods without an initializer must be declared in a constructor function.")
			return
		}
		return
	}
	functionNode := GetFunctionDecl(n)
	if functionNode == nil {
		Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "@abstract", "only functions or non-static methods can be abstract")
		return
	}
	if !info.IsConstructor() && NodeUtil.GetFunctionBody(functionNode).HasChildren() {
		Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "@abstract", "function with a non-empty body cannot be abstract")
		return
	}
	if NodeUtil.IsEs6ConstructorMemberFunctionDef(n) {
		Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "@abstract", "constructors cannot be abstract")
		return
	}
	if !info.IsConstructor() && !n.IsMemberFunctionDef() && !n.IsStringKey() && !n.IsComputedProp() && !n.IsGetterDef() && !n.IsSetterDef() && !NodeUtil.IsPrototypeMethod(functionNode) {
		Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "@abstract", "only functions or non-static methods can be abstract")
		return
	}
	if n.IsStaticMember() {
		Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "@abstract", "static methods cannot be abstract")
		return
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:368
func hasClassLevelJsDoc(info *rhino.JSDocInfo) bool {
	return info.IsConstructorOrInterface() || info.HasBaseType() || info.GetImplementedInterfaceCount() != 0 || info.GetExtendedInterfacesCount() != 0
}

// Warns when nocollapse annotations are present on nodes which are not eligible for property
// collapsing.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:379
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateNoCollapse(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil || !info.IsNoCollapse() {
		return
	}
	if n.IsFromExterns() {
		ReportMisplaced(n, "nocollapse", "This JSDoc has no effect in externs.")
		return
	}
	if NodeUtil.IsPrototypePropertyDeclaration(n.GetParent()) || n.GetParent().IsClassMembers() && !n.IsStaticMember() {
		ReportMisplaced(n, "nocollapse", "This JSDoc has no effect on prototype properties and non-static fields.")
	}
	if n.IsAssign() {
		assignee := n.GetFirstChild()
		if assignee.IsQualifiedName() {
			rootOfQname := NodeUtil.GetRootOfQualifiedName(assignee)
			if !rootOfQname.IsName() {
				ReportMisplaced(n, "nocollapse", "This JSDoc has no effect.")
			}
		}
	}
}

// Checks that JSDoc intended for a function is actually attached to a function.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:407
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateFunctionJsDoc(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil {
		return
	}
	if info.ContainsFunctionDeclaration() && !info.HasType() && !IsJSDocOnFunctionNode(n, info) {
		ReportMisplaced(n, "function", "This JSDoc is not attached to a function node. " + "Are you missing parentheses?")
	}
}

// Whether this node's JSDoc may apply to a function

// <p>This has some false positive cases, to allow for patterns like goog.abstractMethod.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:428
func (c *CheckJSDoc) isJSDocOnFunctionNode(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) bool {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
}

// Checks that annotations for messages ({@code @desc}, {@code @meaning} and
// {@code @alternateMessageId}) are in the proper place, namely on names starting with MSG_ which
// indicates they should be extracted for translation. A later pass checks that the right side is
// a call to goog.getMsg.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:472
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateMsgJsDoc(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil {
		return
	}
	hasNonDescMsgTag := info.GetMeaning() != nil || info.GetAlternateMessageId() != nil
	if hasNonDescMsgTag / / Don't error on TS gencode using @desc on a non-message. There's a lot of code that
        // uses @desc as a general purpose "@desc" tag
        || (info.getDescription() != null && !isFromTs(n)) {
		descOkay := false
		switch n.GetToken() {
		}
		if !descOkay {
			Report(n, MISPLACED_MSG_ANNOTATION)
		}
	}
}

// Returns whether of not the given name is valid target for the result of goog.getMsg
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:501
func isValidMsgName(nameNode *rhino.Node) bool {
	if nameNode.IsName() || nameNode.IsStringKey() {
		return nameNode.GetString().StartsWith("MSG_")
	} else if nameNode.IsQualifiedName() {
		return nameNode.GetString().StartsWith("MSG_")
	} else {
		return false
	}
}

// Check that JSDoc with a {@code @type} annotation is in a valid place.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:512
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateTypeAnnotations(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info != nil && info.HasType() {
		valid := false
		switch n.GetToken() {
		}
		if !valid {
			ReportMisplaced(n, "type", "Type annotations are not allowed here. " + "Are you missing parentheses?")
		}
	}
}

// Is it valid to have a type annotation on the given NAME node?
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:560
func isTypeAnnotationAllowedForName(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	CheckState(n.IsName(), n)
	if !NodeUtil.IsLValue(n) {
		return false
	}
	rootTarget := NodeUtil.GetRootTarget(n)
	return !NodeUtil.IsLhsOfAssign(rootTarget)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:572
func (c *CheckJSDoc) reportMisplaced(n *rhino.Node, annotationName string, note string) {
	compiler.Report(JSError.Make(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, annotationName, note))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:576
func (c *CheckJSDoc) report(n *rhino.Node, typ string, arguments []string) {
	compiler.Report(JSError.Make(n, typ, arguments))
}

// Check that an arrow function is not annotated with {@constructor}.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:581
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateArrowFunction(n *rhino.Node) {
	if n.IsArrowFunction() {
		info := NodeUtil.GetBestJSDocInfo(n)
		if info != nil && info.IsConstructorOrInterface() {
			Report(n, ARROW_FUNCTION_AS_CONSTRUCTOR)
		}
	}
}

// Check that a rest parameter has JSDoc marked as variadic.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:591
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateRestParameter(restParam *rhino.Node) {
	if !restParam.IsRest() || !restParam.GetParent().IsParamList() {
		return
	}
	paramList := restParam.GetParent()
	inlineInfo := restParam.GetFirstChild().GetJSDocInfo()
	functionInfo := NodeUtil.GetBestJSDocInfo(paramList.GetParent())
	var paramTypeAnnotation *rhino.JSTypeExpression
	if inlineInfo != nil {
		paramTypeAnnotation = inlineInfo.GetType()
	} else if functionInfo != nil {
		if restParam.GetFirstChild().IsName() {
			paramName := restParam.GetFirstChild().GetString()
			paramTypeAnnotation = functionInfo.GetParameterType(paramName)
		} else {
			indexOfRest := paramList.GetIndexOfChild(restParam)
			paramTypeAnnotation = func() any { if functionInfo.GetParameterCount() >= indexOfRest { return functionInfo.GetParameterType(functionInfo.GetParameterNameAt(indexOfRest)) }; return nil }()
		}
	} else {
		paramTypeAnnotation = nil
	}
	if paramTypeAnnotation != nil && paramTypeAnnotation.GetRoot().GetToken() != Token.ITER_REST {
		compiler.Report(JSError.Make(restParam, BAD_REST_PARAMETER_ANNOTATION))
	}
}

// Check that a parameter with a default value is marked as optional. TODO(bradfordcsmith): This
// is redundant. We shouldn't require it.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:627
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateDefaultValue(n *rhino.Node) {
	if n.IsDefaultValue() && n.GetParent().IsParamList() {
		targetNode := n.GetFirstChild()
		info := targetNode.GetJSDocInfo()
		if info == nil {
			return
		}
		typeExpr := info.GetType()
		if typeExpr == nil {
			return
		}
		typeNode := typeExpr.GetRoot()
		if typeNode.GetToken() != Token.EQUALS {
			Report(typeNode, DEFAULT_PARAM_MUST_BE_MARKED_OPTIONAL)
		}
	}
}

// Check that @modifies annotations are only present in externs.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:648
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateNoSideEffects(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil {
		return
	}
	if n.IsFromExterns() {
		return
	}
	if info.HasSideEffectsArgumentsAnnotation() || info.ModifiesThis() {
		Report(n, INVALID_MODIFIES_ANNOTATION)
	}
}

// Check that a let declaration is not used with {@defines}
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:664
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateDefinesDeclaration(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info != nil && info.IsDefine() && n.IsLet() {
		Report(n, INVALID_DEFINE_ON_LET)
	}
}

// Checks that an @implicitCast annotation is in the externs
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:671
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateImplicitCast(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if !inExterns && info != nil && info.IsImplicitCast() {
		Report(n, TypeCheck.ILLEGAL_IMPLICIT_CAST)
	}
}

// Checks that a @closurePrimitive {id} is on a function
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:678
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateClosurePrimitive(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil || !info.HasClosurePrimitiveId() {
		return
	}
	if !IsJSDocOnFunctionNode(n, info) {
		Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "closurePrimitive", "must be on a function node")
	}
}

// Checks that there are no annotations on return.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:689
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateReturnJsDoc(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if !n.IsReturn() || info == nil {
		return
	}
	if info.ContainsDeclaration() && !info.HasType() && !info.HasTypedefType() {
		Report(n, JSDOC_ON_RETURN)
	}
}

// Checks that a @tsType is on a function in a supported file
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:700
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateTsType(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil || info.GetTsTypes().IsEmpty() {
		return
	}
	if !IsJSDocOnFunctionNode(n, info) {
		Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "tsType", "must be on a function node")
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:710
func isFromTs(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.GetStaticSourceFile().IsTypeScriptSource()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:716
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateJsDocTypeNames(info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil {
		return
	}
	for _, typeNode := range info.GetTypeNodes() {
		NodeUtil.VisitPreOrder(typeNode, checkJsDocTypesVisitor)
	}
}

// Checks that @usedViaDotConstructor is only used on constructors.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:758
func (c *CheckJSDoc) validateIsUsedViaDotConstructor(n *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) {
	if info == nil || !info.IsUsedViaDotConstructor() {
		return
	}
	if !n.IsFunction() && info.IsConstructor() && !NodeUtil.IsEs6ConstructorMemberFunctionDef(n) {
		Report(n, MISPLACED_ANNOTATION, "usedViaDotConstructor", "must be on a constructor")
	}
}

// Ban any references to compiler internal implementation details
// Inner class CheckJSDoc.CheckJsdocTypes — ported as CheckJSDocCheckJsdocTypes.
type CheckJSDocCheckJsdocTypes struct {
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckJSDoc.java:4
func (c *CheckJSDocCheckJsdocTypes) Visit(typeRefNode *rhino.Node) {
	if !typeRefNode.IsStringLit() {
		return
	}
	typeName := typeRefNode.GetString()
	dot := typeName.IndexOf('.')
	rootOfType := func() any { if dot == -1 { return typeName }; return typeName.Substring(0, dot) }()
	if ClosureRewriteModule.IsModuleExport(rootOfType) || ClosureRewriteModule.IsModuleContent(rootOfType) {
		typeRefNode.SetString("UnrecognizedType_" + typeName)
	}
}
